BrochureContent.Content:
Keogh Auctioneers are delighted to present 3 The Cottages to the market for sale by private treaty. 

This charming town cottage enjoys a superb setting on Lower Windmill Lane, just off South Main Street and Friar Street, and only metres from the waterfront and beach at The Mall.

One of just three idyllic cottages, Number 3 is ideally positioned within an easy stroll of Youghal town centre and its full range of amenities.

Set back from the roadway, the property benefits from an attractive frontage with generous space that could accommodate off-street parking, a garden area, or a combination of both.

This two-storey, two-bedroom cottage follows a traditional layout and is full of charm and character. A half door opens into a short hallway, with a spacious lounge and open fire to the right and a fully fitted kitchen to the left.

A rear stairs leads to the first floor, where there are two double bedrooms and a bathroom.

Number 3 offers a wonderful blank canvas for the discerning buyer, with the potential to create a lovely home that is full of individuality and character. Viewing is highly recommended.
